chunks: He said: “If it is placed in the grave, then that has sufficed him.”

key_terms.أَجْزَأَهُ: it sufficed him; it fulfilled the required obligation
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave; the burial place of the deceased

ai.seo_question: Does placing it in the grave suffice for the deceased?
ai.summary: This report conveys a legal ruling related to funeral handling and what is sufficient in that circumstance. It indicates that placing it in the grave fulfills the required act for the deceased.
